category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The packet does not target sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling, oily or dandruff scalp; the supported production route is the ordinary balanced shampoo bucket.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Strong: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate is the position-2 primary cleanser and is supported by CAPB plus later betaine, glucoside and glucamide routes. Refatting ingredients buffer feel but do not make the net chassis merely ordinary. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: fine — Strong cleansing with only moderate weight makes fine hair usable when damage care is desired, though repeated use may feel drying on already dry lengths. normal — Moderate conditioning and moderate weight balance the strong SLS-led cleanser for normal hair. Conditional (not emitted): coarse — Coarse or very dry hair may need more conditioning than this no-silicone, SLS-led repair shampoo provides.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate is the position-2 primary cleanser and is supported by CAPB plus later betaine, glucoside and glucamide routes. Refatting ingredients buffer feel but do not make the net chassis merely ordinary.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: honey materials, glycerin, glyceryl oleate, glycol distearate, lecithin and cationic guar provide several rinse-off softness routes, but there is no silicone stack, protein system or rich 2-in-1 architecture.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete ordered formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: revealed positioning is for stressed, damaged-looking hair, and the formula has compatible honey/humectant plus refatting/cationic care routes. Confidence stays moderate because the beeswax claim is not visible in INCI.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: no distinct v1.4 secondary focus is supported; honey/beeswax positioning serves the same damaged-looking hair care story rather than an independent route.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the packet is focused on stressed or damaged-looking hair, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp support.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are normal wet-hair massage and rinse-out use and there is no treatment or explicit reset trigger.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: multiple lipid/refatting and cationic guar routes can leave bounded residue, while the SLS-led system and absence of silicone or confirmed beeswax keep the band below high.
